add: # Owner: Father only. Mirrors gate/locked-paths.txt. Agents cannot approve changes here (see SETUP-FATHER.md: agents must not hold this account's token).
# Measures the loop itself weekly and proposes its own tuning as an issue (the recursive part).
- name: Measure needs-agent issues (opened vs fixed, time to fix, tokens per fix)
gh issue list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --label needs-agent --state all --limit 500 --json number,createdAt,closedAt,body,comments > issues.json

jq -r '"## Loop metrics (7d)
" + (.metrics|to_entries|map("- \(.key): \(.value)")|join("
")) + "

## Proposed tuning
" + (.proposals|map("- " + .)|join("
"))' meta.json > meta.md
- name: Open or refresh the loop-tuning proposal issue
n=$(gh issue list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --label loop-tuning --state open --json number -q '.[0].number')
if [ -n "$n" ]; then gh issue comment "$n" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body-file meta.md
else gh issue create -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "[meta-loop] tune the self-improve loop" --label loop-tuning --body-file meta.md; fi
- name: Mirror to Gitbook #67 (only if Father adds a fine-grained GITBOOK_LOG_TOKEN with issues:write on Gitbook)
if [ -z "$GH_TOKEN" ]; then echo "GITBOOK_LOG_TOKEN not set; skipping #67 mirror"; exit 0; fi
# Locked by CODEOWNERS. Policy + script are read from the BASE ref; the PR diff is data only.
# pull_request_target: policy + script are read from the trusted BASE ref (checkout below
# pins base.sha, persist-credentials:false, read-only perms). The PR head diff is data only,
# so a PR cannot rewrite its own lock. pull_request_review dropped (Security #71 / #294).
- name: Collect PR facts from the GitHub API (fail closed on any error)
gh api --paginate "repos/$R/pulls/$PR/commits?per_page=100" | jq -s 'add // [] | map(.author.login // .commit.author.email) | unique' > commits.json
--slurpfile files files.json --slurpfile reviews reviews.json --slurpfile comments comments.json \
- name: Path lock + hard limits (from the real diff)
run: node gate/moderator-lock.mjs lock input.json | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
- name: Gate identity (per-gate GitHub Apps; fails closed until Father configures them)
run: node gate/moderator-lock.mjs gates input.json | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
# 0-token loop: score main, record scores on branch gate-scores, open/refresh one needs-agent issue per finding.
# Writes gate-scores:scores/heartbeat.json for the dead man's switch (deadman.yml reads it; not duplicated here).
fetch-depth: 0 # some v2 tests read git history
- name: Tests (real log is the score source)
set +e; pnpm test > test.log 2>&1; echo $? > test.exit; set -e
run: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do node scripts/bench-latency.mjs > "bench-$i.json" || rm -f "bench-$i.json"; done
run: node scripts/loop/scores.mjs collect test.log "$(cat test.exit)" bench-*.json > scores.json
- name: Compare with last recorded scores
git fetch --depth 1 origin gate-scores 2>/dev/null && git show origin/gate-scores:scores/latest.json > prev.json 2>/dev/null || echo "no previous scores"
node scripts/loop/scores.mjs compare prev.json scores.json > findings.json
- name: Open / refresh / close needs-agent issues
gh label create needs-agent --color B60205 --description "Self-improve finding; agents spend tokens only here" 2>/dev/null || true
- name: Record scores + heartbeat on gate-scores
git fetch --depth 1 origin gate-scores 2>/dev/null && git checkout origin/gate-scores -- scores 2>/dev/null || mkdir -p scores
jq -n --arg sha "$GITHUB_SHA" --arg at "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" --slurpfile f /tmp/s/findings.json '{sha:$sha, at:$at, findings:($f[0]|length)}' > scores/heartbeat.json
ls -1 scores/2*.json | head -n -90 | xargs -r git rm -q --cached --ignore-unmatch 2>/dev/null || true
git add scores && git commit -qm "scores: ${GITHUB_SHA::8}" && git push -q origin HEAD:gate-scores
# Attempts a fix for one needs-agent issue inside the runner with a local open model (llama.cpp + Qwen2.5-Coder GGUF, cached).
# OFF by default: runs only when repo variable TESSERA_WORKER == '1'. Opens a PR only; never merges.
# Locked paths are refused, line cap applies, and the PR goes through moderator-lock + the normal gates.
# fix: runs model output + the issue's test. Read-only token, no write scope, no push.
persist-credentials: false   # no git token on disk during model run / test exec
- name: Fetch llama.cpp + model (cache miss only)
- name: Pick the oldest needs-agent issue from a trusted author
# REST API so author_association is available. Exclude PRs, need file:/test: lines, oldest first.
echo "no workable issue from a trusted author"
- name: Hand the read-only models token over by file (never in the worker's env)
- name: Attempt fix (local model; GitHub Models if vars.WORKER_ENDPOINT is set)
for i in $(seq 90); do curl -sf localhost:8080/health >/dev/null && break; sleep 2; done
set +e; node scripts/loop/worker.mjs . issue.json | tee result.json; rc=$?; set -e
# publish: never runs model code or tests. Fresh checkout, re-derives the one allowed file
# from the issue itself, applies the (untrusted) patch only if it touches exactly that file.
- name: Validate patch (one allowed file, regular, within line cap) and apply
case "$N" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "bad issue number"; exit 1;; esac
[ "$(git status --porcelain=v1 -z | tr '\0' '\n')" = " M $FILE" ] || { echo "patch changed more than $FILE"; exit 1; }
- name: Push branch + open PR (never merge)

Source: Gitbook Moderator review on Gitbook #71 (6:03 AM CT, 2026-10-13). Owner: @vitalitychems-dot via CODEOWNERS.
Only Father edits this file. Tessera and the agents cannot. `gate/moderator-lock.mjs` enforces these rules as code.
- touches a locked path (`gate/locked-paths.txt`): gate rules, gate scripts, `.github/workflows`, CODEOWNERS, branch protection or rulesets, agent prompts, policy files;
- flips `TESSERA_ENABLE_*`, or adds a flag that doesn't default to 0;
- adds a secret, deletes data or a repo, or rewrites history;
- works in a repo other than TESSERA or Gitbook.
2. **Author ≠ approver.** The author is the PR opener plus everyone named in its commits. A gate can't pass its own PR.
3. **Proof:** before/after numbers on fixtures the author didn't build. Wins backed only by synthetic data don't count. Any score drop beyond noise is a FAIL.
4. A claim that can't be verified is marked **REPORTED** and is never evidence for a PASS.
5. A PASS is tied to the exact head SHA. Any new push makes it stale.
6. **Size cap:** 400 changed lines and 10 files (Father sets these). Anything bigger gets split.
7. Hard limits beat "no human in loop": no wallets or payments, no [REDACTED-PATH] no deletes, no history rewrites, no ENABLE flips.
- A `FATHER APPROVED <sha>` **comment never counts**: any agent can post it.
- A review only counts when it comes from `FATHER_LOGIN`, an account that is **not** the agent account, and is APPROVED on the head SHA.
- A gate PASS only counts as a **check run from the gate's own GitHub App** (repo variables `MODERATOR_APP_ID`, `SECURITY_APP_ID`, `BUILD_APP_ID`). PASS comments never count.
- If any of these isn't configured, the check **fails closed**.
| approves itself (gate app is the author) | FAIL |
| stale SHA (PASS on an older head) | FAIL |
| claims a win from synthetic data only | FAIL |
| `FATHER APPROVED` comment / review from the shared account | FAIL |
| ENABLE flip, flag ≠ 0, secret, delete, wallet path, over the size cap | FAIL |
